annotations.title: Skip an incoming message (no reply needed)

description: Mark an incoming message of the line as handled without a reply, with a reason (spam, duplicate, answered elsewhere). It leaves line_inbox pending and stops the no-reply alarm. Only the cable that holds the lease skips; the skip is stamped with the cable and epoch. A message already answered with reply_to stays answered.

message_id.description: message_id of an incoming message from line_inbox.

reason.description: Why it needs no reply (3 to 200 characters), e.g. "spam", "answered in the thread above".

name: line_skip
